links.outcome: LLM performance compared across three institutions with different reporting templates
links.effect: Performance did not differ significantly across the three institutions, indicating robustness to variations in reporting templates.
links.quote: Importantly, performance dose not differ significantly across institutions, underscoring the robustness of these models to variations in reporting templates and their utility in diverse healthcare settings.
